title: Scientists Drilled 7.5 Miles Down. The Earth Fought Back

scenes.text: Scientists drilled seven and a half miles down. The Earth fought back.
It's the Kola Superdeep Borehole in Russia. The hole is only nine inches wide.
At 12,262 meters, the rock hit 180 degrees Celsius, nearly double what they predicted.
The heat made the rock soft, almost like plastic, and it bent their drilling gear.
After twenty years, they were only about a third of the way through the crust.
Seven and a half miles down, and the planet still won.

description:
Scientists drilled seven and a half miles into the Earth, and the heat stopped them.
The Kola Superdeep Borehole hit 180 degrees Celsius, nearly double what was predicted.
The rock turned soft like plastic and bent the drill.
How deep would you have kept going?
first_comment: The hole is wider than a dinner plate but they never got past 12 kilometers. What would you hope to find down there?
